mainEntity.name: How much does commercial refrigeration repair cost in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most commercial fridge and refrigeration repairs cost $200 to $900, plus a call-out fee of about $100 to $250. Coolroom repairs usually sit in the $250 to $900 range. You get a fixed quote before we start, and that is the price you pay.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer emergency commercial fridge repair in Parramatta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A fridge that has stopped cooling is an emergency for a kitchen, so we take after-hours and urgent calls. Book online or email us with the venue, the equipment and what it is doing, and we confirm the fastest time we can get there.

mainEntity.name: What commercial fridges and equipment do you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Display fridges and glass-door merchandisers, bar fridges, under-bench fridges and freezers, upright fridges and freezers, prep and sandwich benches, drink chillers, ice machines and coolrooms. We also repair domestic-style fridges used in small businesses.

mainEntity.name: My commercial fridge is running but not cold. What should I check first?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check the door is closing and the seals are sealing. Then look at the condenser: a coil clogged with dust and grease is the most common cause. Make sure airflow is not blocked by stock or a tight cavity. If it is still warm, switch it off and call us.

mainEntity.name: What temperature should a commercial fridge and freezer be?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cold food should be kept at 5°C or below, and frozen food should stay frozen hard. If a fridge is holding above 5°C, move high-risk food such as meat, dairy and seafood into a working fridge or a cooler with ice and book a repair.

mainEntity.name: Can you repair my fridge without throwing out my stock?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often yes. Many faults, such as a failed fan, a dirty condenser or a bad thermostat, are fixed on the day. We tell you early if the repair will take long so you can move stock to another fridge or a cooler while we work.

mainEntity.name: Do you do planned maintenance for commercial refrigeration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Regular condenser cleaning, seal checks and temperature checks stop most breakdowns before they start. Ask us about a maintenance visit when you book and we will quote it.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair coolrooms, freezer rooms and ice machines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Coolroom, freezer room and ice machine repairs are part of our commercial work. They are quoted separately because the gas, the charge size and the parts are different.

mainEntity.name: Are you licensed to work on commercial refrigeration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our work is carried out by licensed refrigeration mechanics (Lic #R38910) who are ARC licensed to handle refrigerant. We are independent and not tied to any equipment brand, so we tell you plainly when a repair is not worth it.
